description: Converts left and right stereo into mid and side, and back the other way

params.text: Sets the gain applied to the side channel during encoding, which widens or narrows the stereo image
Sets the gain applied to the side channel during decoding, which widens or narrows the stereo image

inputs.text: The left channel into the encoder
The right channel into the encoder
The mid channel into the decoder; with nothing patched it takes the encoder's mid output
The side channel into the decoder; with nothing patched it takes the encoder's side output

outputs.text: Half the sum of left and right, which is the signal as it would be in mono
Half the difference between left and right, after the width gain
Mid plus side scaled by the decoding width
Mid minus side scaled by the decoding width
